policy: Annual observations only, not real-time conditions or forecasts. Latest available years can differ by country and indicator. Cross-country comparisons use exactly the selected reference year; never forward fill or rank different years together. Preserve null/missing observations. Central government debt coverage differs by country and excludes other public sector debt; modeled unemployment is not a national headline estimate. Current-dollar GDP is sensitive to exchange rates. Source revisions can change history; cache timestamps are retrieval dates, not release dates.
